result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the module compiles offline. I did not run the new behaviour: the cli module has no tests, and running `java` was blocked by a permission prompt, so the `-help` output and the report creation are checked by reading the code only.

Changes:
- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description (the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, the same as `updateLandscape`). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`, which stays.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are identical. For `-help`, the usage now prints the name the user typed, with the analyze description when that name is `analyzeLandscape` and the existing description otherwise.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Landscape report" section covering both names and what they create. Say if you would rather keep the README untouched.

Nothing is committed.
